privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How the Nextrole portfolio handles accounts, private résumé versions, submitted applications and privacy requests.
sections: Who operates Nextrole

Nextrole is maintained by its portfolio project owner as an internship demonstration. It is not presented as an operating recruitment agency or an identity-verification service. Contact the operator through Privacy & contact in the app. No personal email address is published. This notice covers this portfolio service. Last updated: 17 October 2026.
Information you provide

An account uses your name, email and Supabase-managed credentials. You may add profile information, private résumé PDFs, application drafts, contact details and cover notes. Employer accounts provide company information and job listings. The app also stores submitted applications, status events, bookmarks, in-product notices, reports, administrative decisions and privacy requests. Use fictional or sample information to evaluate this portfolio; do not upload identity documents, health information, passwords or confidential third-party documents.
Purposes and choices

The service uses this information to authenticate you, save private work, display job information, submit an application when you choose, support company hiring workflows, moderate public content, protect account access and answer privacy requests. Guest browsing requires no account. There are no installed analytics, advertising or audience-tracking services, and Nextrole does not sell your information.
Private files and deliberate sharing

Your private résumé library and drafts are readable by your account only through the app’s data policies. You can keep up to 10 library résumés and 50 private versions, each PDF up to 5 MB. On review, choose a specific version. Submitting shares the displayed name, email, cover note and a separate fixed copy of that selected PDF with the company for that job. Other private files and profile fields are not included automatically. Replacing or deleting a library file does not replace an earlier submission. Withdrawal changes status and does not erase the retained submission.
Role access and moderation

Employers can read applications submitted to their company’s jobs and keep separate private hiring notes. Administrators review account metadata, company access, public job content, reports and privacy requests; their default app access does not include candidate application contents, private résumé libraries or employer notes. Report assignments, investigation notes and private resolution reasons are administrator-only. Only an explicitly entered public report message is shared with the reporter and employer. Infrastructure operators may have technical access needed to operate or handle a verified request; such access must be purpose-limited.
Storage, hosting and international processing

Supabase provides authentication, database and private object storage. This project’s configured primary region is ap-northeast-1, Tokyo, Japan, checked on 17 October 2026. The public web deployment uses Netlify hosting. Provider infrastructure, delivery networks, support and operational logs can involve processing outside that primary region. The primary database region is not a guarantee that every provider operation remains in Japan. Provider notices linked below describe their own processing.
Browser storage and file links

Essential browser storage keeps your signed-in session, privacy preference and a selected job to resume after authentication. Optional analytics storage is unused. Private file links generated by the app expire after 60 seconds; anyone who obtains a live link may use it until expiry. Do not share private file links. Public job-sharing links contain no private file link or application payload.
Retention and deletion

The Retention Policy gives concrete review targets. This portfolio uses monthly operator review, not an automatic erasure job. Private drafts become due after 12 months without editing; terminal applications and their snapshots/notes after 6 months from the final status; closed reports and their investigation records after 12 months; resolved privacy requests after 12 months; read notifications after 90 days; audit records after 12 months. Active accounts and private library versions remain available until you remove them, request deletion or the operator reviews whether they are still needed. A longer documented hold may apply to an unresolved dispute, security incident or required record.
Your requests and operator response

Use Privacy & contact for access, correction, export, deletion and retention questions. Signing in protects your request history and replies; this channel remains available to a suspended account with a valid session. The operator targets a response within 30 days and may need to verify account ownership before disclosing or erasing information. This is a service response target, not a claim of compliance with every jurisdiction’s deadlines. You can directly delete private drafts and library files. Account deletion and data export require operator follow-through; a request status alone does not execute them.
Security, provider records and changes

The app uses authenticated requests, row-level ownership policies, private file buckets and expiring links. No service-role secret is included in the web client. No service can promise perfect security. Provider logs and any separately maintained backups follow the operator’s and providers’ controls; deleting an app record does not promise immediate erasure from every provider record. Supabase database backups contain database metadata, not Storage file bytes. Material changes to this notice are published with a new update date.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: Terms for exploring and evaluating the Nextrole internship portfolio demonstration.
sections: Portfolio demonstration

Nextrole is a software portfolio project for learning and internship evaluation. Company names and sample job descriptions demonstrate interface behavior and do not imply affiliation, endorsement, or a verified vacancy. No hiring, salary, or interview outcome is promised. Last updated: 17 October 2026.
Accounts

Browse without registering. A confirmed account is required to submit applications or manage private files. New accounts are candidates. Employer access requires administrator approval. Administrator roles are assigned through server administration, never public registration. Keep credentials secure and use information you are entitled to provide.
Acceptable use

Do not upload unlawful material, malware, another person's personal information, or confidential documents. Do not attempt to access other accounts or disrupt the service. Use sample data when evaluating the portfolio.
Applications and uploads

Saving a private draft does not submit it. Deliberate submission shares the reviewed name, email, cover note and a fixed copy of the specifically selected PDF version with the company for that job. Employers may update candidate-visible status and retain private notes. Library uploads are PDF only, up to 5 MB each, with up to 10 résumés and 50 private versions. Use sample information to evaluate the portfolio. No verified vacancy or hiring outcome is promised.
Availability and changes
This demonstration may be updated, reset, or discontinued. It is not suitable as the only record of an application or résumé. Features and account services depend on their deployment configuration.
Privacy, requests and applicable rights

The Privacy Policy and Retention Policy describe this portfolio’s handling of information. Contact its operator through the app’s private privacy-request channel. The operator does not present the portfolio as a registered recruitment business or promise jurisdiction-specific compliance. Nothing in these terms limits rights that applicable law does not allow to be limited. A commercial recruitment launch requires a separate operator and jurisdiction review.

cookies.title: Privacy & Storage Preferences
cookies.description: Essential storage, optional preferences, and the absence of analytics in Nextrole.
sections: Essential storage

When you sign in, Supabase stores a session so you remain signed in. A job identifier can be stored to resume your application flow after authentication. We remember your privacy choice in browser storage. These support functionality you request.
Optional storage
No optional analytics, advertising, or tracking scripts are installed. Accepting optional storage currently enables no additional tracking. Rejecting it does not prevent browsing or signing in.
Change your choice

On the website, use the Privacy settings button to reopen the preference notice. You may also clear the site's browser storage to remove the preference and local session. Signing out ends the current app session.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Answers about guest browsing, sign-in, application drafts, privacy, and résumé uploads.
sections: Can I browse without signing in?
Yes. Search all sample jobs, use filters, read job details, and save favorites for the current session without an account.
Why do I need an account to apply?

An account keeps your application drafts and résumé associated with you. If you select Apply as a guest, the app asks you to sign in or create an account and then returns you to the selected opportunity.
Are these real vacancies?

This is an internship portfolio demo. Original sample roles never receive applications. The separate employer-listing workspace demonstrates posting, moderation, submission and status tracking using fictional companies and candidate data. No hiring outcome is promised.
Can I use Google sign-in?
Yes. Choose Continue with Google on the account screen, or use an email account. Apple sign-in is not offered.
What happens after I register?
If email confirmation is enabled, open the confirmation link in your email before signing in. If you forget your password, use Forgot password on the sign-in screen.
Where is my résumé stored?

Your private library stores PDFs and their versions. Choose an exact version when reviewing an application; only a separate copy of that version is submitted. Other files stay private, and replacing or deleting a library file does not change prior submissions.
Does this website track me?
No analytics or advertising service is installed. Essential account storage is used only for the requested account functionality.
How do I delete my information?

Delete private drafts and library files from the app. Withdraw submissions from their details. For account deletion, export or retention questions, open Privacy & contact in Settings. Your private request history contains operator replies. Deletion requests require verified operator follow-through.

contact.title: Privacy & Contact
contact.description: Contact the Nextrole portfolio operator privately through your account.
sections: Contact channel

The Nextrole portfolio operator receives privacy questions through the app’s Privacy & contact screen. Select Open private privacy requests below, sign in and send a request. Replies and status changes appear in your request history. No personal email address, public mailbox or external email reply is promised.
What you can request

Choose access, correction, export, deletion, retention or another privacy question. Describe the request in 10–2,000 characters. Do not include passwords, identity documents, health information, confidential documents or another person’s information. Your account and authorized administrators can read the request; other candidates and employers cannot.
Account access

An authenticated session identifies the account and protects request history. If you cannot sign in, use Forgot password on the sign-in screen. A suspended account can still open this privacy channel while it has a valid session. This portfolio does not provide an unauthenticated public support inbox.
Response and follow-through

The operator targets a response within 30 days. A deletion or export request requires review, appropriate ownership checks and server-side follow-through. The app does not claim automatic erasure when a request is submitted or marked resolved.

retention.title: Data Retention Policy
retention.description: Concrete review targets and deletion responsibilities for the Nextrole portfolio.
sections: How retention is operated

Last updated: 17 October 2026. The operator reviews data at least monthly using the admin Retention review screen and records the review outcome and follow-up in the audit log. The time periods below make records eligible for review. They are not automatic deletion timers. The operator removes or anonymises information that is no longer needed, subject to a documented hold for an unresolved request, dispute, incident or required record.
Accounts, profiles and company information

Keep these while the account and requested service remain in use. Review continued need at least annually and on an account-deletion request. Closing a job or withdrawing an application does not close an account. Account deletion requires verified server administration, including session revocation, dependent data and file handling.
Private drafts and résumé library

Private application drafts are due for review 12 months after their last edit. You may delete them sooner. Library PDFs and their prior private versions remain available while you use the account or until you delete that résumé and its versions. Review continued need annually and on deletion requests. Unfinished uploads and tombstoned metadata require operator housekeeping; deleting a metadata row alone is not file deletion.
Submitted applications and hiring notes

Review a terminal submission 6 months after its status becomes Withdrawn, Rejected or Hired. Review the associated snapshot PDF, contact/cover note, candidate-visible events and employer notes together. An application still being processed remains available for that workflow. Withdrawal or private-file replacement does not delete or mutate the submitted record. Any continued retention after review must have a recorded reason.
Reports and investigation records

Review closed reports, assignments, private investigation notes, resolution summaries and public outcome messages 12 months after resolution or dismissal. Open investigations remain available until resolved or reviewed for continued need. Do not publish private notes as part of a report outcome.
Privacy requests, notifications and audit

Review resolved privacy requests and operator responses after 12 months. Review read in-product notifications after 90 days. Review moderation audit records after 12 months, retaining only what is still needed to explain access or moderation decisions. An audit-review record is not proof that erasure was completed.
Deleting files and handling copies

Private library deletion removes the selected résumé’s object versions through the Storage API before confirming the metadata deletion. Submitted snapshots are separate and require their own retention/deletion process. Operators must delete Storage objects through the Storage API, not merely remove their database metadata. Provider operational logs and any backups or exports are handled under separate provider/operator controls; no fixed provider-wide erasure period is asserted here.
Your choices

Delete your own private files and drafts directly, withdraw an application, or send an in-app privacy request for access, export, correction, deletion or retention questions. The operator targets a response within 30 days and explains any continued retention. This portfolio has no automated bulk erasure, external email notification or public support mailbox.
